title: How To Use Whole Life Insurance To GET RICH (Become Your Own Bank) | Wealth Nation
summary: Insurance agents pitch whole life policies as a tax-free, guaranteed-growth 'own bank' to borrow from and invest with.

assertions.quote: when you access the funds you don't have to pay any penalties the same way that you would with retirement accounts

verdicts.note: Policy loans are generally untaxed and penalty-free, but they accrue interest, early surrender charges apply, and a lapse with loans outstanding can trigger tax.

assertions.quote: the cash in your life insurance policy grows at a tax-free rate
there is nothing that can out earn tax-free compounded interests which is why we say sayonara to our own savings accounts
every time you get a loan you have the ability to apply those same principles that you already understand from the bank and pay yourself
when you pass there aren't two buckets of money at the end of the day it's just one bucket of money

verdicts.note: In standard whole life the insurer pays the face amount minus outstanding loans; the cash value is not paid on top.
